title: Microsoft Entra: Security Copilot agent for private application lifecycle management
summary: The briefing accurately separates the roadmap's planned agent from documented, general Entra and Security Copilot controls. Its dates, licensing framework and stated documentation gaps are supported; a separate Microsoft guide uses a different navigation label for Entra agents.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans an Application Lifecycle Management Agent in Microsoft Entra through Microsoft Security Copilot.
